name: prepare-pr
description: Author-side preflight of draft pull requests before independent code review. Read the complete change set, challenge correctness, fix credible defects, and record test evidence.

interface.longDescription: Author-side PR preflight using the complete branch diff, relevant code, tests and regression risk checks. Does not replace independent review.
interface.defaultPrompt: Prepare my current draft PR for independent review using the full branch diff.
